description: Instagram without Reels, feed or ads: an open-source, updatable Instagram app for Android that keeps DMs and stories.

latest_release.name: FeurStagram v456-0-0-53-78
latest_release.body:
A big update: ads are gone from Reels and Stories again, Instagram's telemetry is blocked, and new options arrive: an unlock timer, ghost mode, grayscale and a switch for comments. Updated to Instagram 456.0.0.53.78.

## ✨ New
- **Unlock timer.** Give yourself a daily (or weekly) allowance to use the surfaces you block: pick which ones, choose 1h, 2h, 5h, 8h, 12h, 24h or a custom time, and start a session from the settings. A pill shows the time left; drag it anywhere, and tap it to pause, resume or skip the session.
- **Block telemetry.** Instagram's background usage analytics are blocked by default, including after this update. Sign-in, security checks and messages are not affected. You can turn it off any time in Settings → Privacy, even with the permanent lock on.
- **Ghost mode.** Three separate options in Settings → Privacy, all off by default: hide your read receipts in messages, hide "typing…", and watch stories without appearing in their viewers.
- **Grayscale.** Settings → Display and popups can now show Instagram without colour: the app, photos, Stories and Reels videos. Only on screen: what you save or share keeps its colours.
- **Hide comments.** A new Comments switch in Blocked surfaces removes comment buttons, counts and previews on posts, Reels and stories.

## 🐛 Fixes
- **No more ads in Reels and Stories.** With Ads blocked, sponsored reels and stories no longer slip through (#177, #178, #181, #185).
- **The settings always open.** "Feurstagram settings unavailable here" no longer shows up when you tap the button on your profile or long-press Home.
- **Stories open again with the story tray hidden.** Stories from a profile or a search are no longer "unavailable" (#180).
- **"Share externally" works again** on Reels and posts: the Android share sheet opens (#182).
- **Shared reels open on the first tap**, even with Reels blocked, without "Something went wrong" (#184).

## 🔧 Under the hood
- Updated to Instagram 456.0.0.53.78.
- Both APKs keep the existing release signature and update in place.
